scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "tsc -w -p shared --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p tools --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run measure-routes
